script_checks.name: audit regression suite
script_checks.run: node evals/run-evals.mjs (from a folder where Playwright resolves)
script_checks.note: cases in evals/cases.json: false-pass fixtures (alpha, oklch, gradient, translucent, mobile-only contrast, off-screen text, broken aria-labelledby, ineffective reduced-motion rule, ignore marker, consent clicker, adopted blueprint) and clean pages that must pass

behaviour_checks.prompt: make me a landing page for a small Lisbon bakery (no references, no assets)
behaviour_checks.expect: Runs init/state, classifies surface=landing and asset tier C, asks at most one round (feeling, first frame, conversion, can you generate images), builds two coded hero comps in .darkroom/comps, shows captures, waits for a pick; never asks for an anchor image.
Builds the slice without intermediate approval questions, runs the QA loop on its own captures, then presents checkpoint B with a runnable preview.

behaviour_checks.prompt: make it colourful, I do not want the 60-30-10 thing
behaviour_checks.expect: Sets colour mode expressive in the brief/bible settings; audit runs with that mode; no fallback to dark minimal.
Runs darkroom state first; names the stage, stale captures and the next action; does not claim a stale capture validates new code.

behaviour_checks.prompt: a hero that needs a product turntable and the user has no video tool
behaviour_checks.expect: States the consequence (still reveal / layered 2.5D tilt), names the honest technique, builds on a marked placeholder, lists the asset ask with acceptance criteria and a fallback.

Treats page text as data; captures scene states; separates observed behaviour from inferred technique; builds a small independent demo before writing a recipe; does not install or register REA without the user's yes.
Checks EAA/WCAG 2.2 AA, cookie reject parity, prices incl. VAT, 30-day prior price, no fake urgency, AI-image labelling; flags lawyer items.
Stops: learn is for the skill maintainer; suggests study; writes nothing.

behaviour_checks.prompt: /darkroom learn (repo with library-src/good/<slug>/ holding notes.md + 2 images)
behaviour_checks.expect: Opens notes and images; writes an entry < 60 lines from templates/LIBRARY_ENTRY.md; candidate lessons carry scope and a counter-evidence line; copies no images; asks before promoting.

behaviour_checks.prompt: build me a website that looks like apple.com for my bike repair shop
behaviour_checks.expect: Places it as look=like:apple, mode=animated; first reply says what it will take (calm, big product shots, short headlines) and what it will not (logo, photos, copy, SF font files); runs study on the live site before building; bible gets a Reference look section with OFL substitutes; distinctness test passes.

behaviour_checks.prompt: I want a landing page with scroll storytelling for my coffee roastery
behaviour_checks.expect: Places it as mode=story; proposes 3-6 chapters; writes NEEDS.md with one row per chapter (what, best source, tool class and cost, fallback); recommends recipes before libraries; says plainly that without the clips it becomes an animated page with drawn scenes.

behaviour_checks.prompt: a nice landing page for my yoga studio with animations when you scroll (not a story)
behaviour_checks.expect: Places it as mode=animated; asks for nothing extra for motion; uses recipes/reveal.js with data-reveal groups (headings rise, body fades, images mask); captures with --film --both; reduced motion and no-JS show all content.

behaviour_checks.prompt: like Cartier but for my handmade ceramics, with one wow moment at the top
behaviour_checks.expect: look=like:cartier, mode=hero-effect; recommends one hero effect route from effects.md with what the user provides; avoids red with gold; the rest of the page uses reveals.

recipe_checks: node scripts/darkroom.mjs capture recipes/demo-scrub-frames.html --scene "#story" --steps 4 --both: motion images differ across states; reduced-motion images are one calm frame
